production authorization or installed storage runtime adoption
hostRequirements: Verify exact native engine/build, encoding/collation/arithmetic and transport settings before any integrity or query SQL.
Keep integrity checks and query evaluation in one admitted catalog/publication context.
Buffer results; refuse integrity, engine, policy, transport or arithmetic failures before publication. No fallback or newer engine selection.
qualificationBoundary: Operation/type/home families qualified by native executions, independently authored expectations and critical semantic branch accounting. Composition across those admitted families does not claim every possible query/model/home cross-product has been executed.

domains.scalar: string/boolean, signed or unsigned integer widths 1..64, decimal precision 1..28 and scale 0..precision

domains.compound: admitted sequence/map/structured graph, exact numeric text leaves, explicit absence, complete row trees
domains.relationships: authored monomorphic directed/inverse edges and exact bounded key bags
domains.paging: complete stable authored keys, exact C comparison; no storage-ID substitution
